remaining_cautions.evidence_context: DRAMP marks C-ori as antimicrobial and anticancer, but local primary material only supports anticancer HT-29 IC50 for C-ori; the antimicrobial label is preserved as source_conflict, not smoothed into source_verified.
Figures 3-4 and Supplementary Figures S1-S2 support directional viability claims, but exact per-bar values are not tabulated and were not invented.
AO/PI staining supports apoptosis morphology, while the membrane/carpet model remains discussion-level inferred context without direct membrane or pathway assays.

residual_source_limitations.impact: C-ori IC50 and qualitative no-effect/combination claims are source-supported; exact per-bar viability percentages are not invented from plotted figures.
Supplementary Figure S1/S2 PDF provides figure-level support but no extractable table; source text supports no-effect calls for CTP-ori/CTP-rds on HT-29.
Mechanism record uses direct_mechanism only for AO/PI morphology and labels the membrane model as inferred context.
